clusters.name: Crypto Miners
clusters.description: Immediately downloads and executes cryptocurrency mining software. Targets GPU-equipped servers. Checks for nvidia-smi, downloads XMRig or custom miners, sets up persistence via crontab.

clusters.name: Credential Harvesters
clusters.description: Systematically extracts credentials and secrets from the filesystem. Targets .aws/credentials, .ssh keys, .env files, /etc/shadow. Often exfiltrates via curl or scp to external servers.

clusters.name: Lateral Movers
clusters.description: Scans the internal network for additional targets. Checks ARP tables, runs ping sweeps, attempts SSH to other hosts using harvested credentials. Indicates sophisticated multi-stage attacks.

clusters.name: Botnet Recruiters
clusters.description: Downloads and installs botnet malware (Mirai variants, IRC bots). Disables security services, modifies iptables to block competing bots, establishes C2 callback. Fully automated with no human interaction.

clusters.name: Reconnaissance Only
clusters.description: Logs in, runs basic system enumeration (uname, whoami, id, df), and disconnects without taking action. Likely automated scanners cataloging vulnerable hosts for later exploitation or sale.

method: TF-IDF on Cowrie command sequences, k-means (k=5), silhouette score 0.72
